title: Existence of the finite-stage common support compositor
statement: Under the hypotheses of [def-pur-rational-purity-common-comparisons], the finite-stage common compact-support functors admit a natural isomorphism whose component at every literal finite stage (i,K) is the composite of the counit-normalized common comparisons and the inclusion of the rational compact-support compositor.

source.place: Steps 4--6, finite-stage descent of the common compact-support compositor.

proof.text: Conjugate the rational compact-support compositor by the counit-normalized finite-stage common comparisons, check compatibility after every finite enlargement, and descend the resulting natural isomorphism to the common-stage category.

proof_origin.place: Steps 4--6, finite-stage descent; split from the uniqueness wrapper.

theorem commonSupportComposition_exists :
    ∃ c : (Sf.ring.operation cf .closed).F ⋙ (Sg.ring.operation cg .closed).F ≅
        (Sfg.ring.operation cfg .closed).F,
      ∀ (i : Index P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar)
        (K : Stage P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar X i),
        (c.hom.app ⟨i,K⟩) =
          (Sg.ring.operation cg .closed).F.map ((Sf.common.commonComparison cf i).q.inv.app K) ≫
          (Sg.common.commonComparison cg i).q.inv.app
            ((Sf.ring.operation cf (.rational
              (commonField P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar i))).F.obj K) ≫
          (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion (Y := Z) i).map
            (by
              have e := rationalSupportComposition P f g cf cg cfg Sf Sg Sfg
                (commonField P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar i)
              have t := e.hom.app K
              exact (commonCategory_eq P Z i) ▸ t) ≫
          (Sfg.common.commonComparison cfg i).q.hom.app K
